final_synthesis_description: All three stakeholders accept the two-phase core — immediately secure the highest-risk litter first, then gently and constructively address the littering camper — while collectively adding that the education/confrontation step should be conditional on safety, feasibility, and risk of escalation, with a ranger or authority escalation pathway available when direct engagement is unsafe or insufficient.
remaining_disagreements: Degree of specificity around when to escalate to a ranger vs. handle independently
Whether face-to-face camper engagement is always required or can be replaced by indirect methods if risk is present
Exact threshold for what constitutes a 'high-hazard' item requiring immediate priority removal
